neighbours.label: a concrete object named as the thing you need, own or use to do something ('all you need is a ___', 'if you own a ___', 'works on any ___')
fire: To take part in the class, all you need is a computer and a quiet room.
The game can be played on any smartphone with a recent operating system.
If you own a sewing machine, you can make the costume in an afternoon.
For this trip, all you need is a tent and a warm sleeping bag.
The lessons can be followed on any laptop with a working webcam.
If you have a printer, you can make your own birthday cards at home.
To make the soup, all you need is a large pot and some fresh vegetables.
If you own a canoe, you can explore the lakes on your own schedule.
quiet: To take part in the class, all you need is some patience and a little curiosity.
The game was popular with teenagers and sold millions of copies within a year.
If you enjoy sewing, you will love the costume workshop this afternoon.
For this trip, all you need is a sense of adventure and a free weekend.
The lessons were popular, and most students passed the exam with ease.
If you are creative, you can make your own birthday cards at home.
To make the soup, all you need is time and a bit of practice in the kitchen.
If you love the outdoors, you can explore the lakes on your own schedule.

notes: Card: devices (computer, radio, TV, smartphone). Probe refuted 'electronic device': laptop 0.87, pan 0.69, television 0.56, backpack 0.45, tablet 0.37, bicycle 0.27, but 'listens on an old transistor radio' 0.16 and 'phone calls'/'heart' (+ pole triggers) ~0.01. So the frame matters more than the device. Quiet items keep the requirement frames but name abstract requirements or none.
